command.simplestats.none: The held item has no statistics
simplestats.guide.page.1.title: Simple Stats
simplestats.guide.page.1: Every tool, weapon and piece of armor counts its own blocks, kills, absorbed damage, distances and catches, with an item-specific statistics screen.
simplestats.guide.page.2.title: Item statistics
simplestats.guide.page.2: Tools, weapons, shields, elytra, fishing rods, brushes, flint and steel and armor (also mount armor) keep their own statistics in the simplestats:item_stats component.
simplestats.guide.page.3.title: Item statistics
simplestats.guide.page.3: Which item counts what is decided by components and item tags (tool, weapon, glider, blocks attacks, armor attributes), not by class, so gear from other mods with vanilla behavior counts too.
simplestats.guide.page.4.title: Item statistics
simplestats.guide.page.4: An item without activity carries nothing and shows nothing.
simplestats.guide.page.5.title: Blocks mined
simplestats.guide.page.5: Every block broken with a tool counts for that tool, listed by block, including blocks with zero hardness.
simplestats.guide.page.6.title: Blocks mined
simplestats.guide.page.6: Every way of mining ends in the item's mine-block call, so Vanilla, other mods and (with Simple Hammers) the sledgehammer count the same way: an area break with the hammer counts each block.
simplestats.guide.page.7.title: Blocks mined
simplestats.guide.page.7: Changes are collected per tick and written once.
simplestats.guide.page.8.title: Kills and damage
simplestats.guide.page.8: A kill counts for the weapon that caused it, by mob and by mob variant (cat type, sheep color, baby, charged creeper, slime size, villager profession and the vanilla variant components).
simplestats.guide.page.9.title: Kills and damage
simplestats.guide.page.9: Damage dealt and the biggest single hit are recorded, a mace smash gets its own record. Arrows only carry
simplestats.guide.page.10.title: Kills and damage
simplestats.guide.page.10: a copy of the bow, so the real bow is found again through a random statistic id stored on it:
simplestats.guide.page.11.title: Kills and damage
simplestats.guide.page.11: an arrow kill counts for the bow even after the hand changed. Thrown tridents carry their statistics with them. Killing a player counts as a number only, without a name.
simplestats.guide.page.12.title: Armor, shields and wearing time
simplestats.guide.page.12: Damage that armor and its enchantments take away is split among the worn pieces in proportion to their armor points (an approximation); fall damage goes to the boots. Mount armor on animals counts too.
simplestats.guide.page.13.title: Armor, shields and wearing time
simplestats.guide.page.13: The list shows the absorbed amount by damage type. A shield counts blocked attacks and blocked damage by attacker.
simplestats.guide.page.14.title: Armor, shields and wearing time
simplestats.guide.page.14: Wearing time is handed to the worn armor and elytra every ten seconds, when a player leaves and when a worn piece changes hands within that interval its time may land on the new piece.
simplestats.guide.page.15.title: Distances and flights
simplestats.guide.page.15: Boots count the walked, sprinted, sneaked and swum distance; the glider counts distance flown, flights, rocket boosts and the longest flight.
simplestats.guide.page.16.title: Distances and flights
simplestats.guide.page.16: The numbers come from the vanilla movement statistics (the mod does not measure anything itself) and are handed to the items every ten seconds, at the end of a flight and when a player leaves.
simplestats.guide.page.17.title: Special tools
simplestats.guide.page.17: Axes count stripped logs, hoes tilled soil, shears sheared mobs by kind and color, brushes finished suspicious blocks,
simplestats.guide.page.18.title: Special tools
simplestats.guide.page.18: flint and steel its fires, and fishing rods casts and catches (by item and as fish, treasure or junk).
simplestats.guide.page.19.title: Tooltip and statistics screen
simplestats.guide.page.19: The tooltip shows one headline value and the hint Shift: details; with Shift it shows the most important values.
simplestats.guide.page.20.title: Tooltip and statistics screen
simplestats.guide.page.20: Hold an item (or hover it in any inventory, chest or trading screen) and press the key (default I, rebindable) to open the statistics screen of that item:
simplestats.guide.page.21.title: Tooltip and statistics screen
simplestats.guide.page.21: totals and records, then every counted block, mob, catch and damage type with its amount and share, sorted by amount, with a scroll bar.
simplestats.guide.page.22.title: Size, inheritance and reset
simplestats.guide.page.22: Lists are as complete as what was counted. The only protection is a byte budget per item (default 32 KB, setting maxBytes):
simplestats.guide.page.23.title: Size, inheritance and reset
simplestats.guide.page.23: once it is used up, new entries are no longer listed and are summed as others, known entries keep counting and totals stay exact. The data carries a version field;
simplestats.guide.page.24.title: Size, inheritance and reset
simplestats.guide.page.24: a value written by a newer version is shown but never changed. A smithing upgrade keeps the statistics, the anvil keeps those of the left item, crafting-grid repair makes a new item without them.
simplestats.guide.page.25.title: Size, inheritance and reset
simplestats.guide.page.25: Statistics can only be cleared with /simplestats reset.
simplestats.guide.page.26.title: Who counts and who sees
simplestats.guide.page.26: Everyone who sees an item sees its statistics: nothing is hidden and no owner is stored, so sharing an item shares its numbers.
simplestats.guide.page.27.title: Who counts and who sees
simplestats.guide.page.27: Players in Creative or Spectator mode and machine players of other mods do not count (settings countCreative and countFakePlayers). Settings:
simplestats.guide.page.28.title: Who counts and who sees
simplestats.guide.page.28: enabled, trackMining, trackCombat, trackArmor, trackDistances, trackFishing, trackTools, trackPlayerKills and maxBytes in config/simplestats.json.
simplestats.guide.page.29.title: Commands
simplestats.guide.page.29: /simplestats reset clears the statistics of the held item, /simplestats show lists the raw values, /simplestats reload reads the settings again. Game master permission required.
